items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Was that Pernacier's? ... Oh, yeah. Pierre Nourie, the women Pernacier, is the one that started the Hot Club of France. And so I used to go to the house and listen to the ladies and things they had.

ctx.x: I prize those records I've got of him and Garvin Bouchelle on clarinet. Yeah. Yeah. Did you keep in touch with Hotline Records or what, the scene over here? Because you've heard of these guys.
Well, I used to belong to the, while I was over there, I belonged to the Hot Club of France and was traveling. Was that Pernacier's?
Was that Pernacier's deal? Yes. Pernacier.
